name: Derek Foferek
bio:
Derek Foferek, located in Matthews, United States, is a tattoo artist known for his exceptional skill in bringing pop culture to life on skin. Specializing in comics, anime, cartoons, video games, and neotraditional styles, he showcases his talent at @mimiktattoo in Charlotte, NC. Clients rave about Derek's ability to translate their favorite fictional worlds into stunning and detailed tattoos.
